name: Jaisalmer Fort
tagline: Living golden fort above the city
description: The iconic 12th-century Golden Fort, one of the few living forts in the world with residents, havelis, guesthouses and temples inside its sandstone walls. Staying here offers unmatched views and immersive heritage atmosphere.
bestFor: Heritage lovers wanting to sleep inside a living fort with views

name: Sadar Bazaar
description: The bustling main market area just below the fort, lined with shops, textiles, street food and havelis like Patwon ki Haveli. Central and lively, it puts you within walking distance of the fort and most attractions.
bestFor: Travellers wanting central access to markets, food and fort on foot

name: Gadisar Lake
description: The area around the historic Gadisar Lake southeast of the fort, a tranquil man-made reservoir ringed by ghats, shrines and ornate gateways. Quieter guesthouses here offer calm water views away from the market bustle.
bestFor: Travellers seeking a quieter, scenic base with lake and temple views

name: Ville Outskirts and Highway
tagline: Modern hotels and desert camp gateway
description: The newer developed areas along the roads out of town toward Sam Sand Dunes, home to modern resorts, larger hotels and quieter guesthouses. This base suits those wanting comfort, space and easy desert safari departures.
bestFor: Comfort seekers and desert-trip travellers wanting modern rooms and space
